Decision for AC-11347: DENIED — Jordan Lee will not be granted direct expanded write/ALTER privileges on customer-billing-prod.  
Approved alternative(s): permit the approved 3‑hour bulk remediation only if executed either (A) directly by the on‑call DBA under dual‑control with Jordan observing/validating, or (B) by the approved runbook‑executor service that runs only the pre‑approved, signed/hashed parameterized scripts that Jordan may trigger as a pass‑through (Jordan receives no write token).
